uv: a uv.lock beside the file marks a uv project, so the [tool.uv] table is appended.
-- changes --
[{"name":"urllib3","ecosystem":"pypi","to":"2.2.2","method":"override","file":"pyproject.toml"}]
-- in:pyproject.toml --
[project]
name = "app"
dependencies = ["requests>=2.31"]
-- in:uv.lock --
version = 1
-- out:pyproject.toml --
[project]
name = "app"
dependencies = ["requests>=2.31"]

[tool.uv]
override-dependencies = ["urllib3==2.2.2"]
